method: Official provider pages read using web tool; supporting excerpts are recorded without asserting checkout acceptance. No expiry date inferred from a campaign name. Existing 14-day evidence age limit applies.

observations.title: Hostinger VPS: up to 70% off the introductory term
observations.excerpt: Up to 70% off. KVM 4: $12.99/mo. Today you pay $311.76 for 24 months. Renews at $28.99/mo.
observations.terms: Introductory VPS promotion; discount varies by plan. The observed KVM 4 quote required 24 months prepaid and displayed a higher renewal. Currency, tax, location, eligibility and account conditions may change the quote. No public coupon is asserted. Check the full payment and current renewal at checkout; not checkout tested.

observations.title: SiteGround StartUp: advertised 88% off the first term
observations.excerpt: StartUp. Save 88%. $1.99/mo. Renews at $17.99/mo. Prepaid for 12 months.
observations.terms: Observed StartUp introductory web-hosting offer, prepaid for 12 months. The source displayed $1.99 per month initially and $17.99 per month on renewal in its USD view. Confirm currency, tax, eligibility, included services and the complete invoice in your checkout. This is not a permanent renewal discount or a coupon code; not checkout tested.

observations.title: Cloudways: 80% off two introductory months, subject to cap
observations.excerpt: 80% OFF for 2 months. Up to $200 off per month.
observations.terms: Short introductory promotion advertised on the provider pricing page, capped at up to $200 off per month. Confirm eligible product, account, activation method, exclusions, later recurring price and offer availability. An 80% reduction for two months is not an 80% annual saving. No checkout or code has been tested.

observations.title: Kinsta: 50% off three introductory paid months
observations.excerpt: Black Friday: 50% off for 3 months. Pay $17.50 for 3 months after the first month, renews at $35.
observations.terms: Observed promotion on selected monthly WordPress configurations; the source described three discounted paid months after a separate introductory first month. Annual billing has a different offer. Confirm plan, account eligibility, usage limits, extras, currency and the post-promotion price. This is not a lifetime or full-year 50% reduction; not checkout tested.
